Figure 1:(a) In OPSD, the self-teacher provides guidance indiscriminately across all samples without improving its own capabilities, thereby degrading the quality of supervision delivered to the student.
(b) TESD improves the self-teacher using the environmental rewards of its rollouts while delivering adaptive guidance by down-weighting samples with unreliable supervision.
(c) TESD achieves more continuous performance improvement than current OPSD methods.

Figure 2:Top:We plot the task correctness and teacher confidence (measured by mean token probability) of each student rollout, with the color representing its edit distance to the privileged context.Bottom:The evolution of the model’s teaching ability during the training process, which is estimated by the mean spearman correlation between teacher confidence and actual rewards.
Experiments are conducted on the Physics subset of SciKnowEval using Qwen3-8B.

Figure 3:Overall framework of TESD. Given an input query, the student first generates rollouts, which provide the privileged context for the self-teacher. Then, TESD optimizes the student and the self-teacher, respectively. For the self-teacher, it interacts with the environment and learns from the obtained rewards of correctness and independence. For the student, it is supervised by the logits of the self-teacher. The loss value is adaptively weighted by the teacher’s mean reward of the corresponding input query, which estimates the quality of teacher guidance.

Figure 4:We report the evolution of the standard deviation of accuracy across 16 evaluations (a), the model’s average response length (b), teaching ability (c), and the distillation loss (d) across the training process.
Figure 5:Token-level teacher credit heatmaps of SDPO and TESD with Qwen3-8B on the Physics dataset.
Figure 6:Distributions of the mean reward (top) and the adaptive weight (bottom) of the input batch.
Figure 12:The time cost of different methods during the training process. Experiments are conducted on the LCBv6 benchmark using Qwen3-8B.
